description: This file defines the Drupal Select form element class, including properties, processing, and rendering logic for select dropdowns and multi-selects within Drupal forms.

classes.name: Select
classes.description: A Drupal form element class for rendering select dropdowns and multi-select lists, with processing and rendering methods.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties and configuration for the select form element.

methods.name: processSelect
methods.description: Processes the select element to handle multiple selections and empty options, and sets default sorting start index.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Determines the value of the select element upon form submission, handling multiple and empty options.

methods.name: preRenderSelect
methods.description: Prepares the select element for rendering by setting attributes.
